company.name: DNA Script
company.shortDescription: DNA Script is a disruptive DNA synthesis company harnessing biology to accelerate breakthroughs in life science and human health.
company.description: DNA Script is a disruptive DNA synthesis company engineering biology to accelerate breakthroughs in life science and human health. Their revolutionary enzymatic technology powers the world's first benchtop DNA printer, SYNTAX, enabling labs to print their own synthetic oligos for greater workflow control and faster access to results.

productsAndServices.description: An automated benchtop DNA printer for in-house enzymatic synthesis of ready-to-use single-stranded DNA oligos from 15 to 120 nucleotides, with up to 96 oligos produced in parallel overnight.
productsAndServices.name: SYNTAX® Platform

productsAndServices.description: A DNA Script service for custom single-stranded DNA oligos up to 500 nucleotides, including complex sequences such as poly(A) tails, ITRs, high-GC regions, and sequences with secondary structure.
productsAndServices.name: Custom ssDNA Oligo Synthesis Service

productsAndServices.description: Reagent and consumable kits for enzymatic synthesis of ready-to-use DNA oligos on the SYNTAX® Platform, supporting 96- or 384-well workflows for genomics, gene synthesis, and protein mutagenesis.
productsAndServices.name: SYNTAX® Kits

aiResearchSummary.text: DNA Script is researching inkjet-assisted enzymatic nucleic acid synthesis and cleavage and inkjet-assisted enzymatic nucleic acid synthesis, developing methods, devices and compositions for template-free enzymatic synthesis of polynucleotides on solid supports, including scarless template-free enzymatic synthesis of polynucleotides and massively parallel enzymatic synthesis of nucleic acid strands; together these works target enzymatic DNA and RNA construct generation, synthesis control, and recovery.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $4,700,000, or 1.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 4 disclosed grants total $15,100,000, representing 4.73% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $63,940,722 to $669,221,908, a 10.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (+7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
